risk_note: F1-08fa (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ④, D10-1740 / D10-1741; landed per D10-1772). Read-only admin balance ledger page under the menu id ledger: a required UID query, then the user's fund summary (adminGetUserFundSummary) and the ledger entries (adminListLedgerEntries: paging, filters by type / sub-type / sub-account / accounting day / ref, amounts signed from the user's view, a null balance_after shown as —), and an 导出记录 entry to /exports. No 导出当前筛选 button (D10-1740: the ledger export resource is a separate contract task, button follows as F1-08fb). Amounts only through @couli/money; type and sub-account names from the admin dictionary, the code shown when a row is missing. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context): 30 tests; another independent Claude spec-test pass with one S2. Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); couli-ci verify:fast run 1 and --browser run 1 green before rebase. The path is RV2 by ops/risk-map.yaml, so the code review is a money review (the tool refused general). Written by hand.
